etsy.title: Nutmeg Vintage Botanical Print, Myristica fragrans, Antique Köhler's Medizinal-Pflanzen Plate, Printable Herbal Wall Art
etsy.description:
Nutmeg (Myristica fragrans), from Köhler's Medizinal-Pflanzen, 1887.

Did you know? To protect its nutmeg monopoly, in 1667 the Netherlands kept the tiny island of Run in the Banda Islands and left Manhattan to England in exchange.

INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item is shipped.
Sizes: ISO A-series (A4, A3, A2), 4:5 (8x10, 11x14*, 16x20), 2:3 (12x18, 16x24, 24x36). High resolution 300 dpi JPG.

Restored from public-domain 19th-century plates, re-composed on warm paper with the Latin, Turkish and English names. Print at home, at a local print shop or online.

From Bitki Tabanı (bitkitabani.com), a non-commercial, source-based encyclopedia of medicinal and ritual plants.
